purpose: govern epistemic confidence of Runtime preclassification, not organizational health or structural consistency.

diagnostic_non_contamination_boundary.rule: The Runtime shall not use observed organizational pathology, MMABP structural inconsistency, VSM dysfunction or AHE signals as negative evidence for confidence. Confidence measures the epistemic stability of the observation, not the health of the observed organization.

contradiction_categories.epistemic_contradiction_pending: incompatible evidences prevent determining the canonical fact without clarification
contradiction_categories.business_structural_inconsistency_observ: evidences are clear and show real business parts are inconsistent; does NOT auto-reduce confidence

mmabp.rule: conformance precedes consistency; preserve factual reality; consistency analysis later

block_7: preclassification and epistemic boundary, not diagnosis
